note: Campers-association-run campground on 60+ acres on the Little Red Deer River just east of Sundre, mostly members' annual sites, with a small set of sites for weekend camping and some monthly sites. Treed sites, gated with 24-hour staff, general store, ball diamonds, cook shelters, river beaches and a dog beach; river swimming, fishing and tubing. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: C$25 overnight confirmed (plus weekly/monthly/yearly rates), phone-only booking, free showers/laundry/dump. LONG-STAY DROP CANDIDATE: the map marks only ~19 of ~350 sites for weekend (overnight) camping; annual sites by waitlist. Riverfront -> riverview recommended. Google 4.5/191.
flags: LONG STAY - DROP CANDIDATE (test 4): the operator markets 'MONTHLY CAMPING $350.00 per month' and 'YEARLY CAMPING $1,350 per year', annual sites go to association members from a waitlist ('join the Campground Association as an annual camper with a site year-round ... you will be added to the waitlist'), and the campground map highlights only about 19 sites in yellow as 'bookable for weekend camping' (252, 253, 254, 283, 238, 239, 240, 201-207/207A, 217, 218 and one lettered site) against roughly 350 numbered sites (1-343 plus lettered sites), with ~12 green monthly sites (B1-B12) and ~14 orange group areas (A-N). That is about 1 site in 18 sold for short stays - under the 1-in-10 line. Test 1 pass (nights for sale by phone), test 2 pass (C$25 nightly posted), test 3 fail-ish (mostly annual members), test 4 FAIL (~5% overnight), test 5 pass (no homes sold). I read it as mostly seasonal. Google 4.5 from 191 reviews (so the under-4 auto-drop does not apply); reviewer's call.

PRESENCE: https://www.westwardhocampground.ca/ answered 200 and is this campground (phone 403-556-2568; Wix site, footer (c)2020, no dated rate page - the rates are on the live home page). Google Maps 'Westward Ho Campground' 4.5 from 191 reviews, phone +1 403-556-2568. RV Life stored 4 stars, $. PRICE GATE: C$25 - passes. No online engine, so no occupancy check possible.

OWNERSHIP: run by the Westward Ho Campers Association, 'maintaining our not-for-profit status' - private is right for a non-profit operator. The campground map carries the Mountain View County logo; land ownership not stated.

WATERFRONT (stored riverfront - recommend riverview): the operator says the campground is 'on the banks of the Little Red Deer River', and members' annual sites line the bank along the south meander and the east side. The sites a visitor can book (yellow) are not on the bank: on imagery 252-254 sit on the north edge ~55-65 m from the river across an open grassy flood bench (a view is plausible), 238-240 and 201-207/217-218 are ~60-100 m from the east bank behind other members' rows, a road and trees. Recommend riverview (from the 252-254 bench); not riverfront.
PIN (51.78900,-114.51000): on Twp Rd 325A in the middle of the campground, which spans the road; Google 51.78805,-114.50782. Within ~150 m of the sites' centre. OK.
SEASON: the home page says 'over 60 acres of year-round outdoor enjoyment' (annual sites); no overnight season is stated. Left unset.
